hero.title: Eclipse Animator
hero.description: Eclipse Animator is the new Roblox Studio animation plugin inspired by Blender and Moon Animator — inverse kinematics, unparenting, live editing and support for any Roblox animation type, launched as a flagship free alternative to Moon Animator. For a limited launch window you can claim it free and keep it forever before it becomes paid-only. This wiki covers the whole Eclipse Animator Roblox story: the free-claim window, the install and setup, the IK animation workflow, and how it stacks against Moon Animator and Studio's built-in editor.

aboutGame.title: What Is Eclipse Animator?
paragraphs: Eclipse Animator is a Roblox Studio animation plugin released in October 2026, inspired by Blender's animation workflow and positioned as the flagship free alternative to Moon Animator after that plugin went paid. Its feature set reads like a community wish-list: inverse kinematics with a toggle, unparenting for complex rigs, live editing while the timeline plays, and support for any Roblox animation type — capabilities that previously demanded paid tools or awkward workarounds.

The launch made headlines in the Roblox dev community for its pricing model: free to claim for a limited window — roughly three days — after which the plugin becomes paid-only. Claimed copies stay tied to your account permanently, which turned the launch week into a stampede and the question everyone asks now: did you claim it in time? This wiki documents the Eclipse Animator Roblox plugin from launch — the claim mechanics, the workflow, the comparisons — for the people claiming, the people who missed it, and the people deciding whether to buy.

items.question: What is Eclipse Animator?
items.answer: A Roblox Studio animation plugin released in October 2026, inspired by Blender and Moon Animator. It brings inverse kinematics with a toggle, unparenting, live editing and support for any Roblox animation type to Studio, positioned as the flagship free alternative to Moon Animator.

items.question: Is Eclipse Animator free?
items.answer: It launched with a limited free-claim window — roughly three days — during which claiming the plugin ties it to your Roblox account permanently. After the window closes, the plugin becomes paid-only. If you claimed during the window, yours stays free forever.

items.question: How do I get Eclipse Animator?
items.answer: Through the Roblox Creator Store: the plugin's asset page lives at create.roblox.com, and installing is one click into Roblox Studio. The install guide walks the whole flow, including what claiming means for your account.

items.question: Is it better than Moon Animator?
items.answer: It depends on what you value. Eclipse Animator brings a Blender-inspired workflow, an IK toggle and live editing that Moon Animator lacks; Moon Animator brings years of community familiarity and tutorials. The comparison page lays out workflow, features and price honestly.
